name: M'bour
registryBasis: DGID’s official 2022 magazine explicitly names the Bureau du Cadastre de Mbour and the Bureau des Domaines de Mbour. The current official contact page lists CSF Mbour, and its 2024 official land-service report identifies Mbour as the pilot area for lease/title regularization. These establish specific local cadastre/domain administration; a public anonymous full-polygon endpoint was not verified. Historic office evidence does not prove current parcel-data completeness.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: DGID identifies cadastral/land-domain functions and certified Extrait de plan cadastral / NICAD services. No anonymous public vector parcel endpoint or Mbour-targeted full geometry was verified.
scopeLimits: The Senegal DGID is the national authority for cadastre and land domain records and offers certified cadastral plan extracts; the reviewed service information indicates request-based certified documents rather than an anonymous parcel geometry API. Local Mbour coverage/office assignment was not proven by the available primary map evidence.
remainingUncertainty: The exact parcel coverage of the WUP settlement centroid and the complete public geometry coverage in the locality remain unverified.
